.tick{stroke:var(--hair);stroke-width:1}
.tick-m{stroke:var(--hair-m);stroke-width:1.6}
#orbit{stroke:var(--hair);transform-origin:260px 260px;animation:spin 90s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ring-track{stroke:var(--track)}
#sessionRing{stroke:var(--accent)}
.core-line{stroke:var(--accent)}
.core-dash{stroke:var(--accent)}

/* --- deck ------------------------------------------------------ */
.deck{margin:18px 18px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);padding-top:18px}
.deck-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 18px}
.ph-hint{grid-column:1/-1}
.lbl{
  display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:7px;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.lbl b{color:var(--accent-dim);font-weight:400}
.selwrap{position:relative}
.selwrap::after{
  content:'▾';position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;pointer-events:none;
}
.sel-sm::after{right:9px;font-size:9px}
.select,select{
  appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;
  width:100%;padding:11px 34px 11px 12px;
  background:var(--sel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--ink);
  cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s;
}
select:hover{border-color:var(--accent-dim)}
.sel-sm select{width:auto;min-width:96px;padding:7px 26px 7px 10px;font-size:10px}
.proto-hint{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;
  color:var(--dim);line-height:1.9;
}
.deck-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.btn{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-weight:600;
  padding:13px 20px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid transparent;transition:all .18s;text-transform:uppercase;
  user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;
}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn-primary{
  flex:1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--btn-a),var(--btn-b));
  color:var(--btn-ink);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px var(--btn-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
.btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.btn-primary.is-pause{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--btn2-a),var(--btn2-b));
  color:var(--btn2-ink);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px var(--btn2-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--dim);border-color:var(--line)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent)}
.btn-ghost.active{border-color:var(--hold);color:var(--hold)}
.btn-sm{padding:8px 14px;font-size:10px}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .deck-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .deck-actions{flex-direction:column}
}

/* --- telemetry -------------------------------------------------- */
.stats{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;
  padding:14px 16px 6px;
}
.stat{
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--inset);padding:10px 12px 9px;
}
.stat-v{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:22px;font-weight:400;
  color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.2;
}
.stat-v small{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:1px}
.stat-k{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;
}
.log{
  margin:10px 16px 12px;height:190px;overflow-y:auto;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.85;
  background:var(--logbg);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;
  padding:9px 12px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--hair) transparent;
}
.log::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
.log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--hair);border-radius:3px}
.log-line{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.log-t{color:var(--faint);margin-right:9px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.log-line.ok{color:var(--accent)}
.log-line.info{color:var(--dim)}
.log-line.warn{color:var(--hold)}
.log-line.dim{color:var(--faint)}
.telemetry-foot{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
  padding:0 16px 14px;
}
.t-note{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- audio console ---------------------------------------------- */
.a-rows{padding:12px 16px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.a-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;
  padding:9px 12px;background:var(--inset);
  transition:border-color .2s;
}
.a-row:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent-soft)}
.a-name{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--ink);
}
.a-name em{
  font-style:normal;display:block;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:1px;
}
.sw{position:relative;width:38px;height:20px;flex:none;cursor:pointer;margin-left:auto}
.sw input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;margin:0;z-index:1}
.sw-t{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;transition:.2s}
.sw-t::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--faint);transition:.2s;
}
.sw input:checked + .sw-t{background:var(--accent-tint);border-color:var(--accent-dim)}
.sw input:checked + .sw-t::after{left:20px;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-glow)}
.sliders{padding:12px 16px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.s-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr 62px;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.s-name{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint)}
.s-val{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);text-align:right;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:1px;
}
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:22px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:2px;background:var(--line);border-radius:1px}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;margin-top:-5.5px;
  background:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent-dim);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:2px;background:var(--line);border-radius:1px}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;
  background:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent-dim);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
}
.a-foot{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:14px 16px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.a-note{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- footer ------------------------------------------------------ */
footer{
  max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 20px 30px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);margin-top:14px;
}
.f-left{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint);line-height:2}
.f-left b{color:var(--dim);font-weight:400}
.keys{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.key{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap}
kbd{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--ink);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;
  padding:2px 6px;background:var(--sel);margin-right:5px;
}
@media(max-width:760px){.keys{margin-left:0}}

/* --- toast --------------------------------------------------------- */
.toast{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,12px);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--accent);
  background:var(--toast-bg);border:1px solid var(--accent-dim);
  border-radius:6px;padding:11px 18px;z-index:100;pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;
  box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
  max-width:calc(100vw - 40px);text-align:center;
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

/* --- matrix ocean visualizer overlay ----------------------------- */
#viz{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:none;
  background:#000;overflow:hidden;
  --mx:#00ff41;--mx-glow:rgba(0,255,65,.55);--mx-soft:rgba(0,255,65,.55);
}
#viz.open{display:block}
#vizCanvas{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  display:block;cursor:crosshair;touch-action:none;
}
#viz .fx-vignette{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;
  background:radial-gradient(130% 100% at 50% 42%,transparent 52%,rgba(0,0,0,.62) 100%);
}
#viz .fx-scanlines{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;opacity:.3;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,
    rgba(0,0,0,.28) 0px,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 1px,
    transparent 1px,transparent 3px);
}
#viz .hud{
  position:absolute;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;
  font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:var(--mx);text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--mx-glow);
}
#viz .hud-title{top:18px;left:20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
#viz .hud-sub{top:42px;left:20px;font-size:10px;color:var(--mx-soft);letter-spacing:.14em;text-shadow:none}
#viz .hud-stats{left:20px;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--mx-soft)}
#viz .hud-hint{right:20px;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--mx-soft)}
#viz .caret{animation:blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
#vizClose{
  position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;z-index:5;
  pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;
  color:var(--mx);background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  border:1px solid var(--mx-glow);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 13px;
  transition:all .15s;
}
#vizClose:hover{background:var(--mx-glow);color:#000}
#viz .hud,#vizClose{transition:color .45s ease,border-color .45s ease,background-color .45s ease}
@media(max-width:640px){
  #viz .hud-title{font-size:12px;top:14px;left:14px}
  #viz .hud-sub{top:36px;left:14px;font-size:9px}
  #viz .hud-stats{left:14px;bottom:12px;font-size:10px}
  #viz .hud-hint{display:none}
  #vizClose{top:12px;right:12px;font-size:10px;padding:7px 10px}
}

/* --- theme-change transitions ------------------------------------- */
body,.topbar,.panel,.panel-head,.stat,.a-row,.sw-t,.log,select,kbd,
.crosshair,#orbit,.ring-track,#sessionRing,.core-line,.core-dash,.tick,.tick-m,
.gs-a1,.gs-a2,.gs-a3,.gs-a4,.gs-b1,.gs-b2,.gs-b3,.lg-ring,.lg-dot{
  transition:
    background-color .45s ease, border-color .45s ease, color .45s ease,
    stroke .45s ease, fill .45s ease, box-shadow .45s ease, stop-color .45s ease;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .scanline{display:none}
  #orbit{animation:none}
  .led.on{animation:none}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ======================= TOP BAR ======================= -->
<header class="topbar">
  <div class="brand">
    <svg class="logo" width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle class="lg-ring" cx="11" cy="11" r="9" fill="none" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <circle class="lg-dot" cx="11" cy="11" r="3.4"/>
    </svg>
    <span class="brand-name">STILL<b>POINT</b></span>
    <span class="brand-tag">MEDITATION CONSOLE · v2.5.0</span>
  </div>
  <div class="top-meta">
    <div class="theme-sel">
      <span class="t-lbl">THEME</span>
      <div class="selwrap sel-sm">
        <select id="themeSel" aria-label="Color theme">
          <option value="ocean" selected>OCEAN</option>
          <option value="forest">FOREST</option>
          <option value="ember">EMBER</option>
          <option value="void">VOID</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <span class="clock" id="clock">--:--:--</span>
    <div class="led-group">
      <span class="led-item"><span class="led" id="ledAudio"></span><span>AUDIO</span></span>
      <span class="led-item"><span class="led" id="ledSession"></span><span>SESSION</span></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- ======================= LAYOUT ======================== -->
<main class="layout">

  <!-- ========== BREATHING CORE ========== -->
  <section class="panel" aria-label="Breathing core">
    <div class="panel-head">
      <span class="idx">01</span>
      <span class="panel-title">Breathing Core</span>
      <span class="panel-meta"><span id="remain">--:--</span><span id="cycleRate">3.8 CYC/MIN</span></span>
    </div>

    <div class="stage-wrap">
      <div class="stage" id="stage">
        <div class="scanline" aria-hidden="true"></div>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 520 520" aria-hidden="true">
          <defs>
            <radialGradient id="coreGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
              <stop offset="0%"   class="gs-a1" stop-opacity="0.50"/>
              <stop offset="45%"  class="gs-a2" stop-opacity="0.16"/>
              <stop offset="78%"  class="gs-a3" stop-opacity="0.05"/>
              <stop offset="100%" class="gs-a4" stop-opacity="0"/>
            </radialGradient>
            <radialGradient id="haloGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
              <stop offset="0%"   class="gs-b1" stop-opacity="0.16"/>
              <stop offset="60%"  class="gs-b2" stop-opacity="0.05"/>
              <stop offset="100%" class="gs-b3" stop-opacity="0"/>
            </radialGradient>
          </defs>

          <!-- crosshairs -->
          <line class="crosshair" x1="260" y1="18"  x2="260" y2="58"  stroke-width="1"/>
          <line class="crosshair" x1="260" y1="462" x2="260" y2="502" stroke-width="1"/>
          <line class="crosshair" x1="18"  y1="260" x2="58"  y2="260" stroke-width="1"/>
          <line class="crosshair" x1="462" y1="260" x2="502" y2="260" stroke-width="1"/>

          <g id="ticks"></g>

          <!-- rotating dashed orbit -->
          <circle id="orbit" cx="260" cy="260" r="178" fill="none"
                  stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2 11"/>

          <!-- session progress ring -->
          <circle class="ring-track" cx="260" cy="260" r="252" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/>
          <circle id="sessionRing" cx="260" cy="260" r="252" fill="none"
                  stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"
                  transform="rotate(-90 260 260)" opacity="0.9"/>

          <!-- breathing core -->
          <g transform="translate(260,260)">
            <g id="breathScale">
              <circle id="glow" r="188" fill="url(#haloGrad)" opacity="0.4"/>
              <circle r="150" fill="url(#coreGrad)"/>
              <circle class="core-line" r="150" fill="none" stroke-width="1.4" opacity="0.75"/>
              <circle class="core-dash" r="118" fill="none" stroke-width="1"
                      stroke-dasharray="3 7" opacity="0.28"/>
            </g>
          </g>
        </svg>

        <div class="readout">
          <div class="phase-label p-idle" id="phaseLabel" aria-live="polite">STANDBY</div>
          <div class="phase-count" id="phaseCount">--</div>
          <div class="phase-hint" id="phaseHint">SELECT PROTOCOL · PRESS ENGAGE OR [SPACE]</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- control deck -->
    <div class="deck">
      <div class="deck-fields">
        <div class="field">
          <label class="lbl" for="protoSel"><b>01</b> · Protocol</label>
          <div class="selwrap">
            <select id="protoSel" title="Applies on next engage">
              <option value="box">BOX · 4-4-4-4</option>
              <option value="relax">RELAX · 4-7-8</option>
              <option value="coherent">COHERENT · 5.5</option>
              <option value="purge">PURGE · 4-2-6</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label class="lbl" for="durSel"><b>02</b> · Duration</label>
          <div class="selwrap">
            <select id="durSel" title="Applies on next engage">
              <option value="3">03:00</option>
              <option value="5">05:00</option>
              <option value="10" selected>10:00</option>
              <option value="15">15:00</option>
              <option value="20">20:00</option>
              <option value="30">30:00</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field ph-hint">
          <span class="lbl"><b>03</b> · Phase Map</span>
          <span class="proto-hint" id="protoHint">IN 4S · HOLD 4S · OUT 4S · HOLD 4S</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="deck-actions">
        <button id="engageBtn" class="btn btn-primary">ENGAGE</button>
        <button id="abortBtn" class="btn btn-ghost">ABORT</button>
        <button id="vizBtn" class="btn btn-ghost" title="Open the Matrix Ocean visualizer [V]">VISUALIZER</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <aside class="side">

    <!-- ========== TELEMETRY ========== -->
    <section class="panel" aria-label="Session telemetry">
      <div class="panel-head">
        <span class="idx">02</span>
        <span class="panel-title">Telemetry</span>
        <span class="panel-meta">LOCAL · OFFLINE</span>
      </div>
      <div class="stats">
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat-v" id="statSessions">0</div><div class="stat-k">Sessions</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat-v" id="statMinutes">0<small> MIN</small></div><div class="stat-k">Total Time</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat-v" id="statStreak">0</div><div class="stat-k">Day Streak</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="stat-v" id="statBreaths">0</div><div class="stat-k">Breaths · Live</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="log" id="log" role="log" aria-label="System log"></div>
      <div class="telemetry-foot">
        <span class="t-note">STATE PERSISTS IN LOCALSTORAGE</span>
        <button id="wipeBtn" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">WIPE LOG</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <!-- ========== AUDIO CONSOLE ========== -->
    <section class="panel" aria-label="Audio console">
      <div class="panel-head">
        <span class="idx">03</span>
        <span class="panel-title">Audio Console</span>
        <span class="panel-meta"><span class="led" id="ledAudio2"></span>SYNTH</span>
      </div>

      <div class="a-rows">
        <div class="a-row">
          <span class="a-name">DRONE<em>DEEP PITCH · DETUNED PAIR</em></span>
          <label class="sw"><input type="checkbox" id="tg-drone"><span class="sw-t"></span></label>
        </div>
        <div class="a-row">
          <span class="a-name">NOISE FIELD<em>LOWPASS · SLOW LFO</em></span>
          <label class="sw"><input type="checkbox" id="tg-ocean"><span class="sw-t"></span></label>
        </div>
        <div class="a-row">
          <span class="a-name">BINAURAL Δ<em>THETA RANGE · HEADPHONES</em></span>
          <label class="sw"><input type="checkbox" id="tg-bin"><span class="sw-t"></span></label>
        </div>
        <div class="a-row">
          <span class="a-name">BREATH CUE<em>PHASE-COUPLED SWELL</em></span>
          <label class="sw"><input type="checkbox" id="tg-cue"><span class="sw-t"></span></label>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sliders">
        <div class="s-row">
          <span class="s-name">MASTER</span>
          <input type="range" id="vol" min="0" max="100" value="65" aria-label="Master volume">
          <span class="s-val" id="volVal">65%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="s-row">
          <span class="s-name">BEAT Δ</span>
          <input type="range" id="delta" min="4" max="12" step="0.5" value="8" aria-label="Binaural beat delta in hertz">
          <span class="s-val" id="deltaVal">8.0 HZ</span>
        </div>
        <div class="s-row">
          <span class="s-name">PITCH</span>
          <input type="range" id="pitch" min="44" max="88" step="1" value="55" aria-label="Drone pitch in hertz">
          <span class="s-val" id="pitchVal">55 HZ</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="a-foot">
        <button id="muteBtn" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">MUTE [M]</button>
        <span class="a-note">SYNTHESIZED IN-BROWSER · WEB AUDIO · NO SAMPLES</span>
      </div>
    </section>

  </aside>
</main>

<!-- ======================= MATRIX OCEAN OVERLAY ======================= -->
<div id="viz" aria-hidden="true">
  <canvas id="vizCanvas"></canvas>

  <div class="hud hud-title">matrix.ocean<span class="caret">▌</span></div>
  <div class="hud hud-sub" id="vizSub">REACTIVE VISUALIZER · COUPLED TO BREATH</div>
  <div class="hud hud-stats" id="vizStats">boot…</div>
  <div class="hud hud-hint">move — drift  ·  click / tap — ripple  ·  esc — exit</div>
  <button id="vizClose" title="Close visualizer [Esc]">█ CLOSE [ESC]</button>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>

<script>
(() => {
'use strict';
/* ============================================================
   STILLPOINT OS · runtime
   ============================================================ */
const $  = (s, r=document) => r.querySelector(s);
const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, v));
const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0');
const fmtT  = ms => { const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(ms/1000)); return pad(Math.floor(s/60)) + ':' + pad(s%60); };
const fmtHMS = d => pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds());
const store = {
  get(k,f){ try{ const v = localStorage.getItem(k); return v ? JSON.parse(v) : f; }catch(e){ return f; } },
  set(k,v){ try{ localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} }
};

/* ---------------- config ----------------------------------- */
const PROTOCOLS = [
  { id:'box',      name:'BOX · 4-4-4-4',   phases:[['INHALE',4],['HOLD',4],['EXHALE',4],['HOLD',4]] },
  { id:'relax',    name:'RELAX · 4-7-8',   phases:[['INHALE',4],['HOLD',7],['EXHALE',8]] },
  { id:'coherent', name:'COHERENT · 5.5',  phases:[['INHALE',5.5],['EXHALE',5.5]] },
  { id:'purge',    name:'PURGE · 4-2-6',   phases:[['INHALE',4],['HOLD',2],['EXHALE',6]] }
];
const THEMES = { ocean:'OCEAN', forest:'FOREST', ember:'EMBER', void:'VOID' };

const settings = Object.assign(
  { protocol:'box', duration:10, vol:0.65, delta:8, pitch:55, theme:'ocean',
    on:{ drone:true, ocean:true, bin:false, cue:true } },
  store.get('sp.settings', {})
);
settings.on = Object.assign({ drone:true, ocean:true, bin:false, cue:true }, settings.on || {});
let sessions = store.get('sp.sessions', []);
if (!Array.isArray(sessions)) sessions = [];

const saveSettings = () => store.set('sp.settings', settings);

/* ---------------- theme ------------------------------------- */
function applyTheme(t, silent){
  if (!THEMES[t]) t = 'ocean';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', t);
  settings.theme = t;
  if (themeSel) themeSel.value = t;
  if (typeof Viz !== 'undefined' && Viz.built) Viz.theme();
  if (!silent) saveSettings();
  return t;
}

/* ---------------- clock ------------------------------------ */
const clockEl = $('#clock');
function clock(){
  const d = new Date();
  clockEl.textContent = fmtHMS(d) + ' · ' +
    d.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{month:'short',day:'2-digit'}).toUpperCase();
}
setInterval(clock, 1000); clock();

/* ---------------- log / toast ------------------------------- */
const logEl = $('#log');
function log(msg, cls='dim'){
  const t = (E.state !== 'idle') ? fmtT(performance.now() - E.t0) : fmtHMS(new Date());
  const line = document.createElement('div');
  line.className = 'log-line ' + cls;
  line.innerHTML = '<span class="log-t">[' + t + ']</span>' + msg;
  logEl.appendChild(line);
  while (logEl.children.length > 60) logEl.firstChild.remove();
  logEl.scrollTop = logEl.scrollHeight;
}
let toastT = 0;
function toast(msg){
  const el = $('#toast');
  el.textContent = msg;
  el.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastT);
  toastT = setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
}
const setLed = (id,on) => { const el = $(id); if (el) el.classList.toggle('on', !!on); };

/* ---------------- audio engine ------------------------------ */
const A = {
  ctx:null, master:null, drone:{}, ocean:{}, bin:{}, cue:null, muted:false,

  ensure(){
    if (this.ctx){ if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume(); return; }
    const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AC) return;
    const c = this.ctx = new AC();
    const master = this.master = c.createGain();
    master.gain.value = this.muted ? 0 : settings.vol;
    const comp = c.createDynamicsCompressor();
    master.connect(comp); comp.connect(c.destination);
    this.buildDrone(c); this.buildOcean(c); this.buildBin(c); this.buildCue(c);
    this.applyAll();
    setLed('#ledAudio', true); setLed('#ledAudio2', true);
    log('AUDIO ENGINE · ONLINE', 'ok');
  },
  osc(type, f){ const o = this.ctx.createOscillator(); o.type = type; o.frequency.value = f; o.start(); return o; },
  gain(v){ const g = this.ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = v; return g; },
  noise(){
    const c = this.ctx, len = c.sampleRate * 2,
          b = c.createBuffer(1, len, c.sampleRate), d = b.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i=0;i<len;i++) d[i] = Math.random()*2 - 1;
    const s = c.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = b; s.loop = true; s.start(); return s;
  },
  g(node, v){ if (!this.ctx) return; node.gain.setTargetAtTime(v, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.25); },

  buildDrone(c){
    const d = {};
    d.gain = this.gain(settings.on.drone ? 0.5 : 0);
    d.lp = c.createBiquadFilter();
    d.lp.type = 'lowpass'; d.lp.frequency.value = 320; d.lp.Q.value = 0.6;
    const p = settings.pitch;
    d.o1 = this.osc('sine', p);
    d.o2 = this.osc('sine', p * 1.012);
    d.o3 = this.osc('sine', p * 2);
    d.g3 = this.gain(0.35); d.o3.connect(d.g3);
    d.o1.connect(d.gain); d.o2.connect(d.gain); d.g3.connect(d.gain);
    d.gain.connect(d.lp); d.lp.connect(this.master);
    this.drone = d;
  },
  setDrone(on){ this.g(this.drone.gain, on ? 0.5 : 0); },
  setPitch(p){
    if (!this.ctx) return;
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime, d = this.drone;
    d.o1.frequency.setTargetAtTime(p, t, 0.2);
    d.o2.frequency.setTargetAtTime(p*1.012, t, 0.2);
    d.o3.frequency.setTargetAtTime(p*2, t, 0.2);
  },

  buildOcean(c){
    const o = {};
    o.src = this.noise();
    o.lp = c.createBiquadFilter();
    o.lp.type = 'lowpass'; o.lp.frequency.value = 480;
    o.gain = this.gain(settings.on.ocean ? 0.5 : 0);
    const lfo1 = this.osc('sine', 0.09), lg1 = this.gain(160);
    lfo1.connect(lg1); lg1.connect(o.lp.frequency);
    const lfo2 = this.osc('sine', 0.053), lg2 = this.gain(0.26);
    lfo2.connect(lg2); lg2.connect(o.gain.gain);
    o.src.connect(o.lp); o.lp.connect(o.gain); o.gain.connect(this.master);
    this.ocean = o;
  },
  setOcean(on){ this.g(this.ocean.gain, on ? 0.5 : 0); },

  buildBin(c){
    const b = { base: 160 };
    b.oL = this.osc('sine', b.base);
    b.oR = this.osc('sine', b.base + settings.delta);
    const mkPan = v => {
      if (c.createStereoPanner){ const p = c.createStereoPanner(); p.pan.value = v; return p; }
      return this.gain(0.6);
    };
    b.panL = mkPan(-0.75); b.panR = mkPan(0.75);
    b.gain = this.gain(settings.on.bin ? 0.14 : 0);
    b.oL.connect(b.panL); b.panL.connect(b.gain);
    b.oR.connect(b.panR); b.panR.connect(b.gain);
    b.gain.connect(this.master);
    this.bin = b;
  },
  setBin(on){ this.g(this.bin.gain, on ? 0.14 : 0); },
  setDelta(d){ if (!this.ctx) return; this.bin.oR.frequency.setTargetAtTime(this.bin.base + d, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.15); },

  buildCue(c){
    const q = {};
    q.src = this.noise();
    q.bp = c.createBiquadFilter();
    q.bp.type = 'bandpass'; q.bp.frequency.value = 520; q.bp.Q.value = 0.7;
    q.gain = this.gain(0);
    q.src.connect(q.bp); q.bp.connect(q.gain); q.gain.connect(this.master);
    this.cue = q;
  },
  cueSwell(dur, peak){
    if (!this.ctx || !settings.on.cue || this.ctx.state !== 'running') return;
    const t = this.ctx.currentTime, g = this.cue.gain.gain;
    g.cancelScheduledValues(t);
    g.setTargetAtTime(peak, t, dur * 0.35);
    g.setTargetAtTime(0, t + dur * 0.55, 0.4);
  },
  cueSilent(){ if (this.ctx && this.cue) this.g(this.cue.gain, 0); },

  setVol(v){
    settings.vol = v;
    if (this.master) this.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.muted ? 0 : v, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
  },
  toggleMute(){
    this.muted = !this.muted;
    if (this.master) this.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.muted ? 0 : settings.vol, this.ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
    return this.muted;
  },
  applyAll(){
    this.setDrone(settings.on.drone);
    this.setOcean(settings.on.ocean);
    this.setBin(settings.on.bin);
    this.setPitch(settings.pitch);
    this.setDelta(settings.delta);
    if (this.master) this.master.gain.value = this.muted ? 0 : settings.vol;
  },
  chime(kind){
    if (!this.ctx || this.ctx.state !== 'running') return;
    const c = this.ctx, t = this.ctx.currentTime;
    const note = (f, at, dur, g0) => {
      const o = c.createOscillator(); o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = f;
      const g = c.createGain();
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t + at);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(g0, t + at + 0.02);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + at + dur);
      o.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
      o.start(t + at); o.stop(t + at + dur + 0.05);
    };
    if (kind === 'start') note(880, 0, 0.18, 0.12);
    else { note(523.25, 0, 1.2, 0.18); note(784, 0.12, 1.6, 0.14); note(1046.5, 0.24, 2.0, 0.08); }
  }
};

/* ---------------- matrix ocean visualizer ----------------------
   Full-screen canvas overlay: a wavy sea of 0/1 glyphs with sky rain,
   cheap bloom, CRT scanlines + vignette. Ported from MatrixOcean.html,
   adapted to be theme-aware and to breathe in sync with the session. */
const Viz = {
  open:false, raf:0, built:false,
  W:0, H:0, DPR:1, cx:0, horizonY:0, f:0,
  t:0, last:0, camZ:0, camX:0, yaw:0, cosYaw:1, sinYaw:0,
  mouseTX:0, mouseNX:0, quality:1, far:85, glyphCount:0,
  ripples:[],
  colors:{ base:'#00ff41', mid:'#00d43a', hi:'#eaffe6' },
  sprites:{}, bloom:null, bctx:null,

  cssColor(n){ try{ const c = getComputedStyle(n).color; return c; }catch(e){ return null; } },

  _parseRgb(c){ const m = /rgba?\((\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)[,\s]+(\d+)/.exec(c); return m ? [+m[1], +m[2], +m[3]] : null; },
  theme(){
    // recolor glyphs to match the active console theme (keep a bright head)
    const a = this.cssColor('.brand-name b') || '#00ff41';  // accent
    const b = this.cssColor('.idx') || a;                    // accent-dim
    this.colors.base = a;
    this.colors.mid = b;
    this.colors.hi = '#eef4ff';
    const rgb = this._parseRgb(a) || [0, 255, 65],
          root = document.documentElement;
    if (root){
      const rs = root.style,
            r = rgb[0] + ',' + rgb[1] + ',' + rgb[2];
      rs.setProperty('--mx', a);
      rs.setProperty('--mx-glow', 'rgba(' + r + ',0.55)');
      rs.setProperty('--mx-soft', 'rgba(' + r + ',0.55)');
    }
    this._horizonCol = 'rgba(' + rgb[0] + ',' + rgb[1] + ',' + rgb[2] + ',0.09)';
    // rebuild the baked digit sprites for the new palette
    this.sprites['0'] = [this.bake('0', a), this.bake('0', b)];
    this.sprites['1'] = [this.bake('1', a), this.bake('1', b)];
  },

  bake(ch, color){
    const PX = 96, ASPECT = 0.62,
          W = Math.ceil(PX * ASPECT) + 2, Hh = PX + 2,
          c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = W; c.height = Hh;
    const g = c.getContext('2d');
    g.font = PX + 'px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, "Courier New", monospace';
    g.textAlign = 'center'; g.textBaseline = 'middle';
    g.fillStyle = color;
    g.fillText(ch, W / 2, Hh / 2);
    return c;
  },

  build(){
    if (this.built) return;
    const canvas = this.canvas = document.getElementById('vizCanvas');
    this.ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { alpha:false });
    this.statsEl = document.getElementById('vizStats');
    this.bloom = document.createElement('canvas');
    this.bctx = this.bloom.getContext('2d');
    this.reduced = !!(window.matchMedia && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
    this.resize();
    window.addEventListener('resize', this._rs = () => this.resize());
    window.addEventListener('pointermove', this._pm = e => { this.mouseTX = (e.clientX / Math.max(1, this.W)) * 2 - 1; }, { passive:true });
    canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', this._pd = e => {
      const d = 55;
      this.ripples.push({ x: this.camX + (e.clientX - this.cx) * d / this.f, z: this.camZ + d, t0: this.t });
      if (this.ripples.length > 6) this.ripples.shift();
    });
    this.built = true;
  },

  resize(){
    this.DPR = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    this.W = window.innerWidth; this.H = window.innerHeight;
    const c = this.canvas; if (!c) return;
    c.width = Math.max(2, Math.round(this.W * this.DPR));
    c.height = Math.max(2, Math.round(this.H * this.DPR));
    this.ctx.setTransform(this.DPR, 0, 0, this.DPR, 0, 0);
    this.cx = this.W / 2;
    this.horizonY = this.H / 3;
    this.f = this.H * 1.12;
    this.bloom.width = Math.max(2, (this.W / 4) | 0);
    this.bloom.height = Math.max(2, (this.H / 4) | 0);
  },

  hash2(a, b, k){ const s = Math.sin(a * 127.1 + b * 311.7 + k * 74.7) * 43758.5453123; return s - Math.floor(s); },

  // breathing coupling: inhale lifts the sea floor, exhale sinks it,
  // hold keeps it level — the whole ocean breathes with the user.
  // Reads the live breath-scale so it tracks the smooth phase motion.
  breathOffset(){
    let lvl = 0.5;
    try {
      const sc = parseFloat(document.getElementById('breathScale').getAttribute('transform')) || 0.74;
      lvl = clamp((sc - 0.62) / (1.0 - 0.62), 0, 1);
    } catch (e) {}
    if (E.state === 'run') return 1.4 * (lvl - 0.5) + 0.45 * Math.sin(this.t * 1.25);
    if (E.state === 'pause') return 1.4 * (lvl - 0.5);
    return 1.1 * Math.sin(this.t * 0.5);   // idle ambient swell
  },

  height(x, z, time){
    let h = 0;
    h += 1.35 * Math.sin(x * 0.16 + Math.sin(z * 0.11) * 1.3 + time * 0.70);
    h += 1.10 * Math.sin(z * 0.13 - time * 0.55);
    h += 0.75 * Math.sin((x + z) * 0.075 + time * 0.40);
    h += 0.45 * Math.sin(x * 0.05 - z * 0.09 + time * 0.90);
    for (let n = 0; n < this.ripples.length; n++){
      const r = this.ripples[n], dx = x - r.x, dz = z - r.z,
            d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz), age = time - r.t0;
      h += 2.4 * Math.sin(d * 0.35 - age * 5.2) * Math.exp(-d * 0.055) * Math.exp(-age * 1.1);
    }
    return h + this.breathOffset();
  },

  drawRain(){
    const step = 10, cols = Math.ceil(this.W / step),
          FADE = [0.45,0.28,0.19,0.13,0.09,0.07,0.055,0.045,0.035,0.028,0.022,0.018],
          TRAIL = 12, ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.font = '7px ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    for (let k = 0; k < cols; k++){
      const sp = 45 + this.hash2(k, 3, 1) * 110, off = this.hash2(k, 7, 2) * 900,
            headY = ((this.t * sp + off) % (this.horizonY + 60)) - 30,
            x = k * step + this.hash2(k, 1, 4) * 4;
      for (let m = 0; m < TRAIL; m++){
        const y = headY - m * 5;
        if (y < 8 || y > this.horizonY - 3) continue;
        const hf = Math.min(1, (this.horizonY - y) / 46 + 0.25), a = FADE[m] * hf;
        if (a < 0.01) continue;
        ctx.globalAlpha = a;
        ctx.fillStyle = m === 0 ? this.colors.hi : this.colors.base;
        ctx.fillText(this.hash2(k, m * 13, Math.floor(this.t * 5)) < 0.5 ? '1' : '0', x, y);
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  },

  drawHorizon(){
    const g = this.ctx.createLinearGradient(0, this.horizonY - 70, 0, this.horizonY + 70);
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g.addColorStop(0.5, this._horizonCol || 'rgba(0,255,65,0.09)');
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    this.ctx.fillStyle = g;
    this.ctx.fillRect(0, this.horizonY - 70, this.W, 140);
  },

  drawOcean(){
    this.glyphCount = 0;
    const ctx = this.ctx, W = this.W, H = this.H, CELL = 0.7, NEAR = 2.2,
          CAM_H = 7, f = this.f, cx = this.cx, horizonY = this.horizonY,
          cosYaw = this.cosYaw, sinYaw = this.sinYaw, camX = this.camX,
          camZ = this.camZ, far = this.far, t = this.t;
    const hwPix = W * 0.5,
          wxR = hwPix * cosYaw + f * sinYaw, wzR = f * cosYaw - hwPix * sinYaw,
          wxL = -hwPix * cosYaw + f * sinYaw, wzL = f * cosYaw + hwPix * sinYaw;
    const jMax = Math.floor((camZ + far) / CELL),
          jMin = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((camZ + NEAR) / CELL));
    for (let j = jMax; j >= jMin; j--){
      const wz = j * CELL, rzApprox = wz - camZ;
      if (rzApprox < NEAR) continue;
      let xMin = camX + rzApprox * (wxL / wzL),
          xMax = camX + rzApprox * (wxR / wzR);
      if (xMin > xMax){ const tmp = xMin; xMin = xMax; xMax = tmp; }
      const iMin = Math.ceil((xMin - 2) / CELL), iMax = Math.floor((xMax + 2) / CELL);
      for (let i = iMin; i <= iMax; i++){
        const wx = i * CELL, dx = wx - camX, dz = wz - camZ,
              rx = dx * cosYaw - dz * sinYaw, rz = dx * sinYaw + dz * cosYaw;
        if (rz < NEAR) continue;
        const sc = f / rz, size = CELL * sc;
        if (size < 1.6) continue;
        const sx = cx + rx * sc;
        if (sx < -size || sx > W + size) continue;
        const h = this.height(wx, wz, t),
              sy = horizonY - (h + 0.18 - CAM_H) * sc;
        if (sy > H + size || sy < -size) continue;
        let a = 1 - rz / far;
        if (a <= 0) continue;
        a = Math.pow(a, 1.5);
        a += (h + 1.2) * 0.05;
        if (a > 0.95) a = 0.95;
        if (a < 0.03) continue;
        const ch = this.hash2(i, j, Math.floor(t * 0.9) + i * 17 + j * 31) < 0.52 ? '1' : '0',
              fl = this.hash2(i, j, Math.floor(t * 3.3) + 5),
              ci = fl > 0.82 ? 1 : 0,
              gw = size * 0.62;
        ctx.globalAlpha = a;
        ctx.drawImage(this.sprites[ch][ci], sx - gw / 2, sy - size / 2, gw, size);
        this.glyphCount++;
      }
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  },

  drawBloom(){
    if (this.quality < 0.55) return;
    const ctx = this.ctx, bctx = this.bctx;
    bctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.bloom.width, this.bloom.height);
    bctx.filter = 'blur(2px)';
    bctx.drawImage(this.canvas, 0, 0, this.bloom.width, this.bloom.height);
    bctx.filter = 'none';
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter';
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
    ctx.drawImage(this.bloom, 0, 0, this.W, this.H);
    ctx.restore();
  },

  applyQuality(){ this.far = 85 * (0.5 + 0.5 * this.quality); },

  loop(now){
    if (!this.open) return;
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
    let dt = (now - this.last) / 1000;
    this.last = now;
    if (dt <= 0) return;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.05;
    this.t += (this.reduced ? dt * 0.3 : dt);
    for (let n = this.ripples.length - 1; n >= 0; n--) if (this.t - this.ripples[n].t0 > 9) this.ripples.splice(n, 1);
    this.mouseNX += (this.mouseTX - this.mouseNX) * Math.min(1, dt * 3);
    const sway = this.reduced ? 0 : 0.028 * Math.sin(this.t * 0.21);
    this.yaw = this.mouseNX * 0.10 + sway;
    this.cosYaw = Math.cos(this.yaw); this.sinYaw = Math.sin(this.yaw);
    this.camZ += (this.reduced ? 0 : 7) * dt;
    this.camX = this.mouseNX * 2.5 + (this.reduced ? 0 : 1.8 * Math.sin(this.t * 0.15));

    this._acc = (this._acc || 0) + dt; this._frames = (this._frames || 0) + 1;
    if (this._acc >= 0.5){
      const fps = Math.round(this._frames / this._acc);
      this._statT = (this._statT || 0) + this._acc;
      if (fps < 30 && this.quality > 0.45){ this.quality = Math.max(0.45, this.quality - 0.15); this.applyQuality(); }
      else if (fps > 55 && this.quality < 1){ this.quality = Math.min(1, this.quality + 0.1); this.applyQuality(); }
      this._acc = 0; this._frames = 0;
      if (this._statT >= 0.5){
        this._statT = 0;
        this.statsEl.textContent = 'glyphs ' + this.glyphCount + ' \u00b7 fps ' + fps;
      }
    }
    const ctx = this.ctx;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.W, this.H);
    this.drawRain();
    this.drawHorizon();
    this.drawOcean();
    this.drawBloom();
  },

  toggle(){ if (this.open) this.close(); else this.openViz(); },
  openViz(){
    if (this.open) return;
    this.build();
    this.theme();
    this.open = true;
    const el = document.getElementById('viz');
    el.style.display = 'block';
    document.body.classList.add('viz-open');
    el.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    this.t = 0; this.camZ = 0; this.camX = 0; this.mouseNX = 0; this.mouseTX = 0;
    this.ripples.length = 0; this.last = performance.now();
    this.statsEl.textContent = 'boot\u2026';
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
    log('VISUALIZER · ONLINE · MATRIX OCEAN', 'ok');
    toast('Matrix Ocean — breathe with the waves [Esc to exit]');
  },
  close(){
    if (!this.open) return;
    this.open = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);

/* ---------------- breathing engine -------------------------- */
const RING_R = 252, RING_C = 2 * Math.PI * RING_R;
const MIN_S = 0.62, MAX_S = 1.0;
const E = { state:'idle', proto:PROTOCOLS[0], phaseI:0, phaseT0:0, t0:0,
            pauseAt:0, breaths:0, level:0, raf:0, total:0 };

const phaseLabel = $('#phaseLabel'), phaseCount = $('#phaseCount'), phaseHint = $('#phaseHint'),
      breathScale = $('#breathScale'), glowEl = $('#glow'), sessionRing = $('#sessionRing'),
      engageBtn = $('#engageBtn'), abortBtn = $('#abortBtn'), themeSel = $('#themeSel');

sessionRing.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', RING_C.toFixed(1));
sessionRing.style.strokeDashoffset = RING_C.toFixed(1);

function setPhaseUI(n){
  phaseLabel.textContent = n;
  phaseLabel.className = 'phase-label p-' + (n === 'INHALE' ? 'inh' : n === 'EXHALE' ? 'exh' : 'hold');
}

function startPhase(i){
  E.phaseI = i;
  E.phaseT0 = performance.now();
  const [n, d] = E.proto.phases[i];
  if (n === 'INHALE'){
    E.level = 1; E.breaths++;
    A.cueSwell(d, 0.22);
    log('INHALE · ' + d + 'S', 'ok');
  } else if (n === 'EXHALE'){
    E.level = 0;
    A.cueSwell(d, 0.15);
    log('EXHALE · ' + d + 'S', 'info');
  } else {
    log('HOLD · ' + d + 'S', 'dim');
  }
  setPhaseUI(n);
  phaseCount.textContent = Math.ceil(d);
}

function frame(){
  if (E.state !== 'run') return;
  const now = performance.now();
  let [name, dur] = E.proto.phases[E.phaseI];
  let p = (now - E.phaseT0) / (dur * 1000);
  if (p >= 1){
    startPhase((E.phaseI + 1) % E.proto.phases.length);
    [name, dur] = E.proto.phases[E.phaseI];
    p = 0;
  }
  const e = (1 - Math.cos(Math.PI * clamp(p, 0, 1))) / 2;
  let s;
  if (name === 'INHALE') s = MIN_S + (MAX_S - MIN_S) * e;
  else if (name === 'EXHALE') s = MAX_S - (MAX_S - MIN_S) * e;
  else s = E.level ? MAX_S : MIN_S;
  breathScale.setAttribute('transform', 'scale(' + s.toFixed(4) + ')');
  glowEl.setAttribute('opacity', (0.25 + 0.55 * ((s - MIN_S) / (MAX_S - MIN_S))).toFixed(3));
  phaseCount.textContent = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(dur - (now - E.phaseT0) / 1000));
  $('#statBreaths').textContent = E.breaths;

  const el = now - E.t0, tot = E.total;
  if (el >= tot){ complete(); return; }
  sessionRing.style.strokeDashoffset = (RING_C * (1 - el / tot)).toFixed(1);
  $('#remain').textContent = fmtT(tot - el);
  E.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}

function resetVisuals(){
  breathScale.setAttribute('transform', 'scale(0.74)');
  glowEl.setAttribute('opacity', '0.4');
  sessionRing.style.strokeDashoffset = RING_C.toFixed(1);
}
function standby(){
  resetVisuals();
  setPhaseUI('STANDBY');
  phaseLabel.className = 'phase-label p-idle';
  phaseCount.textContent = '--';
  phaseHint.textContent = 'SELECT PROTOCOL · PRESS ENGAGE OR [SPACE]';
  $('#statBreaths').textContent = '0';
  $('#remain').textContent = '--:--';
  setLed('#ledSession', false);
}
function setEngageUI(){
  if (E.state === 'run'){ engageBtn.textContent = 'PAUSE'; engageBtn.classList.add('is-pause'); }
  else if (E.state === 'pause'){ engageBtn.textContent = 'RESUME'; engageBtn.classList.remove('is-pause'); }
  else { engageBtn.textContent = 'ENGAGE'; engageBtn.classList.remove('is-pause'); }
}

function engage(){
  if (E.state === 'idle' || E.state === 'done'){
    E.proto = PROTOCOLS.find(p => p.id === settings.protocol) || PROTOCOLS[0];
    E.total = settings.duration * 60000;
    E.breaths = 0; E.level = 0;
    E.t0 = performance.now();
    E.state = 'run';
    A.ensure(); A.chime('start');
    resetVisuals();
    setLed('#ledSession', true);
    log('SESSION START · ' + settings.duration + ' MIN · ' + E.proto.name, 'ok');
    startPhase(0);
    cancelAnimationFrame(E.raf);
    E.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    setEngageUI();
    toast('Session engaged — breathe with the ring');
  } else if (E.state === 'run'){
    pause();
  } else if (E.state === 'pause'){
    const d = performance.now() - E.pauseAt;
    E.t0 += d; E.phaseT0 += d;
    E.state = 'run';
    if (A.ctx && A.ctx.state === 'suspended') A.ctx.resume();
    log('RESUME', 'ok');
    cancelAnimationFrame(E.raf);
    E.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    setEngageUI();
  }
}

function pause(){
  E.pauseAt = performance.now();
  E.state = 'pause';
  cancelAnimationFrame(E.raf);
  if (A.ctx && A.ctx.state === 'running') A.ctx.suspend();
  log('PAUSED', 'warn');
  phaseLabel.textContent = 'PAUSED';
  phaseLabel.className = 'phase-label p-hold';
  setEngageUI();
}

function abort(){
  if (E.state === 'idle') return;
  if (E.state === 'done'){ standby(); return; }
  cancelAnimationFrame(E.raf);
  const el = performance.now() - E.t0;
  if (el >= 30000){
    record(Math.round(el / 1000));
    log('PARTIAL SESSION LOGGED · ' + fmtT(el), 'dim');
  }
  log('SESSION ABORTED', 'warn');
  E.state = 'idle';
  if (A.ctx && A.ctx.state === 'suspended') A.ctx.resume();
  A.cueSilent();
  standby();
  setEngageUI();
}

function complete(){
  E.state = 'done';
  cancelAnimationFrame(E.raf);
  const secs = Math.round(E.total / 1000);
  record(secs);
  renderStats();
  A.chime('end'); A.cueSilent();
  log('SESSION COMPLETE · ' + fmtT(E.total) + ' · ' + E.breaths + ' BREATHS', 'ok');
  phaseLabel.textContent = 'COMPLETE';
  phaseLabel.className = 'phase-label p-inh';
  phaseCount.textContent = '✓';
  phaseHint.textContent = 'SESSION LOGGED · READY FOR NEXT CYCLE';
  sessionRing.style.strokeDashoffset = '0';
  toast('Complete — ' + E.breaths + ' breaths logged');
  setEngageUI();
  setTimeout(() => { if (E.state === 'done') standby(); }, 4000);
}

/* ---------------- stats -------------------------------------- */
const dayKey = ts => { const d = new Date(ts); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth()+1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()); };
function streak(){
  const days = new Set(sessions.map(s => dayKey(s.t)));
  let n = 0; const d = new Date();
  if (!days.has(dayKey(d.getTime()))) d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1);
  while (days.has(dayKey(d.getTime()))){ n++; d.setDate(d.getDate() - 1); }
  return n;
}
function record(sec){
  if (sec < 5) return;
  sessions.push({ t: Date.now(), s: sec, b: E.breaths || 0 });
  if (sessions.length > 500) sessions = sessions.slice(-500);
  store.set('sp.sessions', sessions);
}
function renderStats(){
  $('#statSessions').textContent = sessions.length;
  const mins = sessions.reduce((a,s) => a + s.s, 0) / 60;
  $('#statMinutes').innerHTML = Math.round(mins) + '<small> MIN</small>';
  $('#statStreak').textContent = streak();
}

/* ---------------- UI wiring ---------------------------------- */
function updateProtoHint(){
  const proto = PROTOCOLS.find(p => p.id === settings.protocol) || PROTOCOLS[0];
  const map = { INHALE:'IN', EXHALE:'OUT', HOLD:'HOLD' };
  $('#protoHint').textContent = proto.phases.map(p => map[p[0]] + ' ' + p[1] + 'S').join(' · ');
  const cyc = 60 / proto.phases.reduce((a,p) => a + p[1], 0);
  $('#cycleRate').textContent = cyc.toFixed(1) + ' CYC/MIN';
}

/* theme control */
applyTheme(settings.theme && THEMES[settings.theme] ? settings.theme : 'ocean', true);
themeSel.addEventListener('change', e => {
  applyTheme(e.target.value);
  log('THEME · ' + THEMES[themeSel.value], 'info');
  toast('Theme: ' + THEMES[themeSel.value]);
});

const protoSel = $('#protoSel'), durSel = $('#durSel');
protoSel.value = settings.protocol;
durSel.value = String(settings.duration);
updateProtoHint();

protoSel.addEventListener('change', e => {
  settings.protocol = e.target.value;
  saveSettings(); updateProtoHint();
  const proto = PROTOCOLS.find(p => p.id === settings.protocol);
  log('PROTOCOL · ' + proto.name, 'info');
});
durSel.addEventListener('change', e => {
  settings.duration = +e.target.value;
  saveSettings();
  log('DURATION · ' + pad(settings.duration) + ':00', 'info');
});

/* sliders */
const vol = $('#vol'), delta = $('#delta'), pitch = $('#pitch');
vol.value = Math.round(settings.vol * 100);
$('#volVal').textContent = vol.value + '%';
delta.value = settings.delta;
$('#deltaVal').textContent = (+settings.delta).toFixed(1) + ' HZ';
pitch.value = settings.pitch;
$('#pitchVal').textContent = pitch.value + ' HZ';

vol.addEventListener('input', e => {
  A.ensure();
  A.setVol(e.target.value / 100);
  $('#volVal').textContent = e.target.value + '%';
  saveSettings();
});
delta.addEventListener('input', e => {
  A.ensure();
  settings.delta = +e.target.value;
  A.setDelta(settings.delta);
  $('#deltaVal').textContent = settings.delta.toFixed(1) + ' HZ';
  saveSettings();
});
pitch.addEventListener('input', e => {
  A.ensure();
  settings.pitch = +e.target.value;
  A.setPitch(settings.pitch);
  $('#pitchVal').textContent = e.target.value + ' HZ';
  saveSettings();
});

/* toggles */
const TOGGLES = [
  ['drone', 'DRONE',  v => A.setDrone(v)],
  ['ocean', 'NOISE FIELD', v => A.setOcean(v)],
  ['bin',   'BINAURAL',    v => A.setBin(v)],
  ['cue',   'BREATH CUE',  () => {}]
];
TOGGLES.forEach(([key, label, apply]) => {
  const el = $('#tg-' + key);
  el.checked = !!settings.on[key];
  el.addEventListener('change', () => {
    settings.on[key] = el.checked;
    A.ensure(); apply(el.checked);
    saveSettings();
    log(label + ' · ' + (el.checked ? 'ON' : 'OFF'), el.checked ? 'ok' : 'dim');
    if (key === 'bin' && el.checked) toast('Binaural beats — headphones recommended');
  });
});

/* buttons */
engageBtn.addEventListener('click', engage);
abortBtn.addEventListener('click', abort);
$('#vizBtn').addEventListener('click', () => Viz.toggle());
$('#vizClose').addEventListener('click', () => Viz.close());
$('#muteBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  A.ensure();
  const m = A.toggleMute();
  const b = $('#muteBtn');
  b.classList.toggle('active', m);
  b.textContent = m ? 'UNMUTE [M]' : 'MUTE [M]';
  log('MUTE · ' + (m ? 'ON' : 'OFF'), m ? 'warn' : 'info');
});
$('#wipeBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  sessions = [];
  store.set('sp.sessions', sessions);
  renderStats();
  log('LOCAL LOG WIPED', 'warn');
  toast('Local session log cleared');
});

/* keyboard */
window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const tag = (e.target.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
  if (tag === 'select' || tag === 'input' || e.repeat) return;
  if (e.code === 'Space'){ e.preventDefault(); engage(); }
  else if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R'){ abort(); }
  else if (e.key === 'm' || e.key === 'M'){ $('#muteBtn').click(); }
  else if (e.key === 'v' || e.key === 'V'){ Viz.toggle(); }
  else if (e.key === 'Escape'){ Viz.close(); }
  else if (['1','2','3','4'].includes(e.key)){
    const p = PROTOCOLS[+e.key - 1];
    if (p){
      settings.protocol = p.id;
      protoSel.value = p.id;
      saveSettings(); updateProtoHint();
      log('PROTOCOL · ' + p.name, 'info');
      toast('Protocol: ' + p.name);
    }
  }
});

/* ---------------- ticks --------------------------------------- */
(function ticks(){
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const g = $('#ticks'), cx = 260, cy = 260, N = 96;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++){
    const a = (i / N) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
    const major = i % 8 === 0;
    const r1 = major ? 228 : 235, r2 = major ? 246 : 242;
    const l = document.createElementNS(NS, 'line');
    l.setAttribute('x1', (cx + Math.cos(a) * r1).toFixed(1));
    l.setAttribute('y1', (cy + Math.sin(a) * r1).toFixed(1));
    l.setAttribute('x2', (cx + Math.cos(a) * r2).toFixed(1));
    l.setAttribute('y2', (cy + Math.sin(a) * r2).toFixed(1));
    l.setAttribute('class', major ? 'tick tick-m' : 'tick');
    g.appendChild(l);
  }
})();

renderStats();

setEngageUI();

log('STORAGE · LOCAL · OK', 'ok');
log('THEME · ' + THEMES[settings.theme] + ' ACTIVE', 'dim');
log('VISUALIZER · MATRIX OCEAN READY [V]', 'dim');
log('AUDIO ENGINE · STANDBY (INIT ON FIRST GESTURE)', 'dim');
log('SYSTEM IDLE · AWAITING OPERATOR', 'dim');
})();
</script>

.theme-sel{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:14px;
}
.t-lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint);white-space:nowrap}
.clock{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;
  color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
}
.led-group{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:14px}
.led-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint)}
.led{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--hair);flex:none;transition:background .3s}
.led.on{background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);animation:ledpulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ledpulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.45}}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .brand-tag{display:none}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .led-item span,.t-lbl{display:none}
  .clock{font-size:10px}
}

/* --- layout --------------------------------------------------- */
.layout{
  max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px 20px 10px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.55fr) minmax(0,1fr);
  gap:18px;align-items:start;
}
.side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
@media(max-width:1020px){
  .layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .side{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:stretch}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .side{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .layout{padding:16px 12px}
}

/* --- panels --------------------------------------------------- */
.panel{
  position:relative;
  background-color:var(--panel-b);
  background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel-a),transparent 75%);
  border:1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(160,200,255,.04);
}
.panel::before,.panel::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;pointer-events:none;
  border:1px solid var(--accent-soft);
}
.panel::before{top:-1px;left:-1px;border-right:0;border-bottom:0;border-top-left-radius:10px}
.panel::after{bottom:-1px;right:-1px;border-left:0;border-top:0;border-bottom-right-radius:10px}
.panel-head{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);
}
.idx{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--accent-dim);letter-spacing:1px}
.panel-title{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;
  color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;
}
.panel-meta{
  margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint);
  white-space:nowrap;
}

/* --- stage ----------------------------------------------------- */
.stage-wrap{padding:20px 18px 8px}
.stage{position:relative;width:min(100%,450px);margin:0 auto}
.stage svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.scanline{
  position:absolute;left:9%;right:9%;top:14%;height:1px;pointer-events:none;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--accent-soft),transparent);
  animation:scan 7.5s linear infinite alternate;opacity:.6;
}
@keyframes scan{from{top:13%}to{top:89%}}
.readout{
  position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;
}
.phase-label{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;letter-spacing:8px;font-weight:600;
  text-transform:uppercase;transition:color .4s;
}
.phase-count{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:300;
  font-size:clamp(48px,12vw,84px);line-height:1;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:-2px;
  text-shadow:0 0 34px var(--accent-glow);
}
.phase-hint{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  color:var(--faint);max-width:90%;
}
.p-inh{color:var(--accent)} .p-exh{color:var(--exhale)}
.p-hold{color:var(--hold)} .p-idle{color:var(--dim)}

/* svg theming */
.gs-a1,.gs-a2,.gs-a3,.gs-a4,.gs-b1,.gs-b2,.gs-b3{stop-color:var(--accent)}
.crosshair{stroke:var(--hair)}
.tick{stroke:var(--hair);stroke-width:1}
.tick-m{stroke:var(--hair-m);stroke-width:1.6}
#orbit{stroke:var(--hair);transform-origin:260px 260px;animation:spin 90s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.ring-track{stroke:var(--track)}
#sessionRing{stroke:var(--accent)}
.core-line{stroke:var(--accent)}
.core-dash{stroke:var(--accent)}

/* --- deck ------------------------------------------------------ */
.deck{margin:18px 18px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);padding-top:18px}
.deck-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 18px}
.ph-hint{grid-column:1/-1}
.lbl{
  display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  color:var(--faint);margin-bottom:7px;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.lbl b{color:var(--accent-dim);font-weight:400}
.selwrap{position:relative}
.selwrap::after{
  content:'▾';position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  color:var(--dim);font-size:11px;pointer-events:none;
}
.sel-sm::after{right:9px;font-size:9px}
.select,select{
  appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;
  width:100%;padding:11px 34px 11px 12px;
  background:var(--sel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--ink);
  cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s;
}
select:hover{border-color:var(--accent-dim)}
.sel-sm select{width:auto;min-width:96px;padding:7px 26px 7px 10px;font-size:10px}
.proto-hint{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;
  color:var(--dim);line-height:1.9;
}
.deck-actions{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.btn{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-weight:600;
  padding:13px 20px;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid transparent;transition:all .18s;text-transform:uppercase;
  user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;
}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.btn-primary{
  flex:1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--btn-a),var(--btn-b));
  color:var(--btn-ink);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px var(--btn-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
.btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.08)}
.btn-primary.is-pause{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--btn2-a),var(--btn2-b));
  color:var(--btn2-ink);
  box-shadow:0 0 26px var(--btn2-glow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25);
}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--dim);border-color:var(--line)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--accent-dim);color:var(--accent)}
.btn-ghost.active{border-color:var(--hold);color:var(--hold)}
.btn-sm{padding:8px 14px;font-size:10px}
@media(max-width:560px){
  .deck-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .deck-actions{flex-direction:column}
}

/* --- telemetry -------------------------------------------------- */
.stats{
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;
  padding:14px 16px 6px;
}
.stat{
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;
  background:var(--inset);padding:10px 12px 9px;
}
.stat-v{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:22px;font-weight:400;
  color:var(--accent);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;line-height:1.2;
}
.stat-v small{font-size:11px;color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:1px}
.stat-k{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  color:var(--faint);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:2px;
}
.log{
  margin:10px 16px 12px;height:190px;overflow-y:auto;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.85;
  background:var(--logbg);border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;
  padding:9px 12px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:var(--hair) transparent;
}
.log::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}
.log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--hair);border-radius:3px}
.log-line{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.log-t{color:var(--faint);margin-right:9px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.log-line.ok{color:var(--accent)}
.log-line.info{color:var(--dim)}
.log-line.warn{color:var(--hold)}
.log-line.dim{color:var(--faint)}
.telemetry-foot{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
  padding:0 16px 14px;
}
.t-note{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- audio console ---------------------------------------------- */
.a-rows{padding:12px 16px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
.a-row{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
  border:1px solid var(--line-soft);border-radius:8px;
  padding:9px 12px;background:var(--inset);
  transition:border-color .2s;
}
.a-row:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--accent-soft)}
.a-name{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--ink);
}
.a-name em{
  font-style:normal;display:block;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--faint);margin-top:1px;
}
.sw{position:relative;width:38px;height:20px;flex:none;cursor:pointer;margin-left:auto}
.sw input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;margin:0;z-index:1}
.sw-t{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;transition:.2s}
.sw-t::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--faint);transition:.2s;
}
.sw input:checked + .sw-t{background:var(--accent-tint);border-color:var(--accent-dim)}
.sw input:checked + .sw-t::after{left:20px;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-glow)}
.sliders{padding:12px 16px 4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.s-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr 62px;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.s-name{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint)}
.s-val{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--dim);text-align:right;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:1px;
}
input[type=range]{
  -webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:22px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;
}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track{height:2px;background:var(--line);border-radius:1px}
input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
  -webkit-appearance:none;width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;margin-top:-5.5px;
  background:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent-dim);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-track{height:2px;background:var(--line);border-radius:1px}
input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
  width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;
  background:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent-dim);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
}
.a-foot{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;
  padding:14px 16px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.a-note{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--faint)}

/* --- footer ------------------------------------------------------ */
footer{
  max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 20px 30px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);margin-top:14px;
}
.f-left{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--faint);line-height:2}
.f-left b{color:var(--dim);font-weight:400}
.keys{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.key{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap}
kbd{
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--ink);
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:4px;
  padding:2px 6px;background:var(--sel);margin-right:5px;
}
@media(max-width:760px){.keys{margin-left:0}}

/* --- toast --------------------------------------------------------- */
.toast{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:26px;transform:translate(-50%,12px);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--accent);
  background:var(--toast-bg);border:1px solid var(--accent-dim);
  border-radius:6px;padding:11px 18px;z-index:100;pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s,transform .3s;
  box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
  max-width:calc(100vw - 40px);text-align:center;
}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

/* --- matrix ocean visualizer overlay ----------------------------- */
#viz{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:200;display:none;
  background:#000;overflow:hidden;
  --mx:#00ff41;--mx-glow:rgba(0,255,65,.55);--mx-soft:rgba(0,255,65,.55);
}
#viz.open{display:block}
#vizCanvas{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  display:block;cursor:crosshair;touch-action:none;
}
#viz .fx-vignette{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;
  background:radial-gradient(130% 100% at 50% 42%,transparent 52%,rgba(0,0,0,.62) 100%);
}
#viz .fx-scanlines{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;opacity:.3;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,
    rgba(0,0,0,.28) 0px,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 1px,
    transparent 1px,transparent 3px);
}
#viz .hud{
  position:absolute;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;
  font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.08em;
  color:var(--mx);text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--mx-glow);
}
#viz .hud-title{top:18px;left:20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
#viz .hud-sub{top:42px;left:20px;font-size:10px;color:var(--mx-soft);letter-spacing:.14em;text-shadow:none}
#viz .hud-stats{left:20px;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--mx-soft)}
#viz .hud-hint{right:20px;bottom:16px;font-size:11px;color:var(--mx-soft)}
#viz .caret{animation:blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
#vizClose{
  position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;z-index:5;
  pointer-events:auto;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;
  color:var(--mx);background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  border:1px solid var(--mx-glow);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 13px;
  transition:all .15s;
}
#vizClose:hover{background:var(--mx-glow);color:#000}
#viz .hud,#vizClose{transition:color .45s ease,border-color .45s ease,background-color .45s ease}
body.viz-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(max-width:640px){
  #viz .hud-title{font-size:12px;top:14px;left:14px}
  #viz .hud-sub{top:36px;left:14px;font-size:9px}
  #viz .hud-stats{left:14px;bottom:12px;font-size:10px}
  #viz .hud-hint{display:none}
  #vizClose{top:12px;right:12px;font-size:10px;padding:7px 10px}
}

/* --- theme-change transitions ------------------------------------- */
body,.topbar,.panel,.panel-head,.stat,.a-row,.sw-t,.log,select,kbd,
.crosshair,#orbit,.ring-track,#sessionRing,.core-line,.core-dash,.tick,.tick-m,
.gs-a1,.gs-a2,.gs-a3,.gs-a4,.gs-b1,.gs-b2,.gs-b3,.lg-ring,.lg-dot{
  transition:
    background-color .45s ease, border-color .45s ease, color .45s ease,
    stroke .45s ease, fill .45s ease, box-shadow .45s ease, stop-color .45s ease;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .scanline{display:none}
  #orbit{animation:none}
  .led.on{animation:none}
}

    <!-- control deck -->
    <div class="deck">
